title: Enjoyed seeing Italica.  Happy to help preserve this site!
text: Maria met us right at the front gate.  Super knowledgeable and showed us all of the sights of Italica.
author: Sabrina_B

title: Great historical experience
text: Maria, our guide, really brought the whole experience to life - great knowledge in a subject she obviously cared about a great deal. Well tailored commentary to suit audience.
author: FranArkley

title: Italica guide Maria is 5 star.
text: Our guide Maria de Mora. This lovely lady is very passionate about history and made the day relaxed,informative and enjoyable. Her English is excellent and her descriptions bring the historical site to life. 1st class guide.  Thankyou for an amazing tour
author: Julia_W

title: Excellent tour! Must do.
text: We loved our tour with Maria!   Excellent knowledge of Italica. We love Roman history and this tour was great. So thoughtful and personable.  Maria also gave us information about places to go and restaurants and foods that we must try.  Thank you, Maria, very much.   Wonderful time!
author: Anna_S

title: Worth the visit
text: Go learn something about ancient history! Maria was an excellent guide. She gave the whole tour in English and she was very knowledgable and personable. It was a great half day. Bring sunscreen!
author: ingridh599

title: Magnificent visit
text:
Very interesting and very pleasant visit.

Maria explains everything perfect and with her you discover a lot of new things.

Highly recommended.
author: fortfue
